title: 长鑫科技IPO申购抽干A股流动性，上证指数大跌3.05%创近11月低点
summary: A股7月17日重挫：上证综指跌3.05%至3764点，创近11个月新低；深证成指跌5.4%。科创板史上最大IPO长鑫科技（CXMT）申购冻结巨量资金，叠加宇树科技、长鑫存储等超大型上市排队，引发市场恐慌性抛售，半导体板块领跌。
why: A股大幅调整影响港股及中概整体情绪；CXMT IPO为存储赛道重大事件，直接牵动SK海力士、美光对标估值；若持有A股科技仓位需警惕短线回撤。

title: 长鑫科技IPO：华尔街加密合约疯炒、估值从5792亿飙至4万亿，散户212倍超额认购
summary: 长鑫科技（CXMT）7月16日以8.66元/股开启申购，募资逾579亿元，若行使绿鞋可达666亿元，成科创板第二大IPO；散户认购倍数212倍，加密合约盘前隐含估值一度达3.9万亿元，308倍PE引发争议。
why: CXMT上市将重塑A股存储赛道格局，其DRAM量产能力直接威胁SK海力士HBM主导地位；同时体量庞大的新股冻结效应已压制指数短线走势，对卖出put策略需警惕波动率突然放大。

title: Kimi K3 (2.8T-parameter) launch triggers DeepSeek flashback: Nvidia -2% premarket, semiconductor ETF -20%+ from June high
summary: Moonshot AI (Alibaba-backed) released Kimi K3 on July 18 — a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model beating Claude Fable 5 on Frontend Code Arena — causing Nvidia to fall ~2% premarket and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF to extend its decline to more than 20% below its late-June record. Analysts split: Patrick Moorhead called it 'an over-reaction shockingly similar to DeepSeek panic.'
why: 中国AI高效模型冲击重演——影响英伟达GPU需求预期，同时利好阿里巴巴/月之暗面在AI基础设施叙事上的估值；对持有NVDA卖put头寸需关注隐含波动率（IV）短线上行风险。

title: Gold pulls back to ~$4,016, down ~28% from January all-time high of $5,595
summary: Gold has declined sharply from its January 2026 record high, driven by hawkish Fed signals (~60% odds of a September rate hike) and elevated energy prices from Middle East tensions. Goldman Sachs year-end target remains $4,900; JPMorgan's Q4 target is $4,500.
why: 金价大幅回调直接影响老铺黄金（6181.HK）和黄金珠宝板块估值；持有相关仓位需重新审视支撑；sell put策略下行风险加大。

title: 金价半年跌超28%，老铺黄金市值蒸发千亿：门店客流冷清、二手折价、按克金上架
summary: 新浪7月18日实地探访老铺黄金（6181.HK）门店，发现客流明显减少，二手市场出现较大折价，部分门店开始按克定价销售，股价当日跌逾4.6%。自2025年7月高点（1102港元）至今跌幅超65%，市值蒸发逾千亿港元。
why: 金价深度回调正在侵蚀老铺黄金的品牌溢价逻辑；门店客流恶化是先行指标，预示下季收入或进一步承压；持仓者需评估是否调整行权价或行权时机。

title: Pop Mart surges 6.9% on World Cup MEGA LABUBU 400% edition launch (HK$1,625/unit, 1 per person)
summary: Pop Mart (9992.HK) introduced the 'MEGA LABUBU 400% World Cup 26' figure at HK$1,625, strictly limited to one per person. The limited-edition collab drove a single-day stock jump of approximately 6.9%, highlighting Labubu's continued monetization power as a flagship IP.
why: 联名限定款验证Labubu IP持续吸金能力，为即将公布的业绩提供正向预期修正；段永平三度增持背书价值逻辑，对持仓者信号偏正。

title: Circle wins OCC national bank charter (First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.) — stock rallied ~5%
summary: Circle received final approval from the OCC to operate First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A., a national trust bank. The regulatory milestone sent CRCL shares up approximately 5% on the news day and validates Circle's long-term strategy to embed USDC into the regulated banking system.
why: 银行牌照批准是Circle发展史上里程碑事件，显著提升USDC合规可信度；与今日GENIUS Act截止日共同构成Circle的关键监管周——短线波动可能较大，需监控期权IV。

title: Intel 18A-P moves to risk production; foundry yield rises to 85%; Nvidia and OpenAI among confirmed customers
summary: Intel Foundry announced that Intel 18A-P (the performance-enhanced variant of 18A) has entered risk production on schedule. Foundry yield has improved from 65% to 85%, and Intel has secured orders from Nvidia, AMD, Marvell, Microsoft, Micron, and OpenAI. The process node offers up to 9% higher performance or 18% lower power versus base 18A.
why: 18A良率大幅提升并获Nvidia/OpenAI订单，是英特尔代工转型最重要的正面信号；若商业良率如期于2026年末达标，将显著改善代工业务亏损局面，有助于股价修复。

title: SanDisk SNDK: Goldman raises target to $2,200; Motley Fool projects $3,000 by year-end; NAND supply tight into 2027
summary: Goldman Sachs raised its SanDisk (SNDK) price target to $2,200 (from $1,200) on July 5, citing continued NAND supply tightness. The Motley Fool (July 15) projected $3,000 by year-end. SanDisk has surged ~4,885% since its February 2025 Nasdaq debut. Q4 FY2026 earnings are due August 5.
why: NAND价格持续紧张叠加分析师目标价大幅上调，对持有SNDK仓位的投资者是正向信号；8月5日财报为下一关键催化点，可考虑在财报前布局sell put以赚取时间价值。

title: Disney 'Moana' live-action misfires with $43M U.S. opening — down 38% vs. prior weekend market
summary: Disney's live-action 'Moana' remake opened to just $43M domestically, significantly underperforming expectations as the entire marketplace was down 38% from the prior weekend. The result raises questions about Disney's live-action remake strategy and franchise monetization.
why: Moana开局不佳令市场对迪士尼票房回升预期降温；迪士尼内容+流媒体商业模式受质疑，短线股价承压；对DIS持仓者需关注管理层是否下调内容指引。

title: Meituan earnings call: Keeta Saudi Arabia nearing month-1 profitability; Q1 2026 revenue CNY91B (+5.6%), net loss CNY6.8B
summary: Meituan's earnings call highlighted that Keeta's Saudi Arabia operations are expected to achieve profitability within their first full month of operation. Q1 2026 saw revenue rise 5.6% YoY to CNY91B, but a net swing to a CNY6.8B loss (vs. CNY10.1B profit a year ago) due to intensified competition and overseas spending. Full-year new-business losses expected below 2025 levels.
why: Keeta出海盈利节点提前是重要积极信号——验证海外扩张可行性，有助于收窄估值折价；国内业务竞争激烈仍是短期压力，关注下一季Keeta利润数据改善节奏。

title: DeepSeek developing in-house AI chip for inference workloads, reducing reliance on Nvidia GPUs
summary: Reports indicate DeepSeek is designing its own semiconductor focused on inference workloads — a move that could reduce dependency on Nvidia hardware. The chip is still in development and would primarily serve DeepSeek's own inference needs at scale.
why: DeepSeek自研芯片若成真，长期削弱Nvidia在中国推理市场的需求；配合Kimi K3冲击，中国AI自给自足叙事持续强化，对NVDA的中国收入预期构成下行压力。
